report.summary: Transaction SMS and push alerts were delayed by 5-10 minutes due to latency spikes and degradation in the external sms-vendor service starting around 14:00 UTC, leading to consumer group message backlogs in notification-service.

supporting.note: Latency up anomaly detected starting at 14:05 with peak of 1569ms
Logs show sms-vendor send taking over 5.5 seconds
Logs show sms-vendor send taking over 8.5 seconds
Consumer group lag warnings appearing due to slow downstream vendor calls
Past incident shows similar symptom of delayed SMS alerts caused by sms-vendor
Credential rotation performed earlier in the day on notification-service

contradicting.note: Credential rotation occurred at 07:38, several hours before symptoms began at 14:00

facts.text: Users reported payment confirmation SMS/push arriving 5-10 minutes late since ~14:00.
notification-service depends synchronously on sms-vendor and push-provider and asynchronously on event-bus.
sms-vendor p99 latency experienced an anomaly starting at 2026-10-12T14:05:00+00:00 reaching a peak of 1569ms.
notification-service logged multiple slow requests to sms-vendor and consumer group lag on notif-alerts.

assumptions: The 5-minute discrepancy between user-reported onset and metric anomaly onset is within normal telemetry reporting bounds.
Synchronous blocking on sms-vendor caused thread pool saturation and backpressure on the event-bus consumer group.
evidence_gaps: notification-service metric query failed with 503 Service Unavailable.
2 of 3 log shards timed out, resulting in partial log results.

timeline.event: Users report delayed transaction SMS/push alerts
Consumer group lag warning logged for notif-alerts
Incident reported by support lead Fatima

recommended_actions.action: Engage SMS vendor support to check for gateway congestion or throttling.
recommended_actions.rationale: External vendor latency is the primary bottleneck causing notification delays.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers and asynchronous timeout controls for sms-vendor calls.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents slow external vendor calls from blocking notification-service worker pools and causing message queue lag.

recommended_actions.action: Establish secondary vendor failover for SMS delivery.
recommended_actions.rationale: Mitigates future third-party vendor outages and latency spikes.

gaps: query_metrics(service=notification-service) failed: query_metrics backend returned 503 Service Unavailable after 3 tries
